item.title: 17A Cardigan Street, Arrowtown - Niseko Japan Real Estate Photographer
item.body:
About us

Property Media Japan specialises in Real Estate Photography, Videography, Aerial Photography, Floor-plans and Virtual Staging. Previously based in Queenstown New Zealand, we are now operating in Niseko, Hokkaido Japan.

Located in the serene town of Arrowtown, this charming residence at 17A Cardigan St. offers a tranquil retreat with a perfect blend of rustic appeal and functional living.

The property has been thoughtfully maintained and features three cozy bedrooms and two well-appointed bathrooms. The heart of the home is undoubtedly the spacious living room, adorned with large, picturesque windows that fill the space with natural light and offer stunning views of the lush surroundings.

The kitchen is practical and inviting, equipped with essential appliances and ample cabinetry, ideal for preparing meals with a view through its wide window. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area serves as a lovely space for family gatherings. Additionally, the home includes a versatile space that seamlessly transitions between a study area and guest room, maximizing the use of every square inch.

Each bedroom is a private haven, with the master bedroom providing a peaceful escape, complete with a dedicated bathroom. The additional bedrooms are perfect for family or guests, each styled with comforting decor and equipped with essential furnishings.

Outdoor living is equally impressive, with a charming verandah that invites you to relax and enjoy the scenic beauty of the area. The property’s exterior is framed by a vibrant garden and a practical driveway, although the garage specifics were not provided.

This property does not just offer a home; it presents a lifestyle of peace and convenience, ideally suited for those looking to enjoy the best of Arrowtown and nearby Niseko. Whether as a family home or a seasonal getaway, 17A Cardigan St. is a place where memories are waiting to be made.
